summary: Aluminium T-slot extrusion (15, 20, 30 and 40 series, MakerBeam and MakerBeamXL), length along z and centred on the origin by default; length is the second argument. `t` variants (E2020t, E4040t) add a recessed channel (`extrusion_channel_recess` in extrusions.scad) over the plain E2020/E4040 profile.

options.center: centre the length on z = 0 (default true); false puts one end on z = 0
options.cornerHole: draw the corner holes where the profile has them

checks.source: 2020 profile: 20 x 20 section; z is the 100 mm length argument
2040 profile: 20 x 40 section, long side on y; z is the 100 mm length argument
